title: Pineapple Cake
description: Pineapple Cake is a Taiwan dish made with chicken egg, all-purpose flour, milk powder, pineapple. This home-scale recipe assigns measured ingredients to the steps where they are used. Home pineapple cakes use an all-pineapple filling, instead of common pineapple/winter-melon blends.

steps.instruction: Beat the listed ingredients until pale and light; ensure butter and eggs are at room temperature when specified.
Gently fold in the remaining dry or wet ingredients just until homogeneous, without deflating the mixture.
Cook finely chopped pineapple with sugar until the mixture is very thick, golden and no longer wet; cool thoroughly before filling the pastry.
Place a portion of prepared filling on each leaf or wrapper, tuck in the sides and roll tightly into neat parcels.
Roast in a preheated 190°C oven for about 24 minutes until nicely browned and fully cooked; turn once if needed.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
